request.system: You read what an older person typed into a shopping box. List every product they want to buy, in the order they gave. For each, copy their own words for it exactly, such as "a night light", and write a short shop search query that keeps the sizes, colours and other must-haves they gave. Something sold as one product, such as salt and pepper shakers, is one thing. If they typed nothing to buy, return an empty list.

messages.content: batteries, a night light, a phone charger, a doormat, a kettle and a flashlight

content.text: {"things":[{"words":"batteries","query":"batteries"},{"words":"a night light","query":"night light"},{"words":"a phone charger","query":"phone charger"},{"words":"a doormat","query":"doormat"},{"words":"a kettle","query":"kettle"},{"words":"a flashlight","query":"flashlight"}]}
